subject.title: fix(ios): show agent avatars and use more sidebar space

question: Should maintainers accept this small iOS sidebar polish after a current-main refresh, or prefer a different native-menu presentation direction?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the branch presents a bounded implementation and visual proof.

options.title: Refresh and approve
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, rerun the focused iOS Simulator coverage, and approve if the native menu still displays the intended avatar badges and footer.

options.title: Request a presentation change
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a different avatar or sidebar treatment if the current SwiftUI menu rendering does not match the desired iOS design.
